# sh-fpv-sheet-manage-boundaries

**Purpose:** Hide, Block or Report her profile.

**Switches:** Step = Choose → confirm (Hide / Block) or Report reasons.

**Rules:** after confirming, the profile shows its end state (You hid / You blocked / You reported) and the action bar changes (Unhide Her / Unblock Her / We’re reviewing your report).

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 4 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2891-59058) (node `2891:59058`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### Step=Choose

**When:** Footer "Hide, Report or Block Profile" tapped — pick an action.

### Step=Hide · confirm

**When:** Confirm hiding her profile → profile state "You hid her profile", bar Unhide Her.

### Step=Block · confirm

**When:** Confirm blocking → "You blocked her", bar Unblock Her.

### Step=Report · reasons

**When:** Pick report reasons → "You reported her", bar "We’re reviewing your report".
